verdict.rationale: Docs mention governance controls like MCP server allow lists, sandboxed execution environments, and centralized audit logs/control planes for agents, which touch on limiting agent access, but there is no explicit mention of issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials/tokens for an agent. missing for 10: explicit scoped API credential/token issuance mechanism, documentation of permission granularity per agent, and independent verification of least-privilege enforcement.
